comment: Blocked independent upward non-potion impact recipe for dothrow.c:toss_up() -> weapon.c:dmgval(). This hard boulder does not take the breaking-object or potion branch, so the source reaches dothrow.c:hitfloor(obj, TRUE) after calculating damage. JS intentionally records the discarded void callee with note_unported("dothrow.c hitfloor") until that source function is ported; this recipe is not matching evidence.
